notices: Terms and query templates are retrieval aids, not quotations or verified claims.
Variants are not automatic synonyms for event definitions or identities.
No search campaign, source ingestion, paid API calls or recurring monitoring is performed by this file.

concepts.interpretation_caution: Require humans as the affected population; species extinction is a different outcome.
Translation varies; do not assume every occurrence means literal human extinction.
Catastrophe, irreversible harm and extinction are not synonymous.
A capability demonstration, hypothetical scenario and forecast need separate classifications.
Identify the mechanism and harm scale rather than converting generic risk to p(doom).
Chinese safety/security overlap; classify the domain using context.
Normative commitments or techniques do not establish demonstrated safety.
A policy threshold or test success rate is not an unconditional disaster probability.
Retain the source definition and task population; no universal threshold is assumed.
Specify whether the comparison is one task or general capability.
A product schedule, hope or target is not automatically a probabilistic forecast.
Announcement, access and withdrawal dates differ; API aliases can change serving models.
Preserve dataset version, split, evaluator, scale and protocol.
Topic labels are not standardized metrics.
Do not pool mismatched tests; percentage points are not percent change.
Repeated citations or identical tables are not independent replications.
Retain hardware, precision, currency, denominator and cost boundaries.
Total versus activated parameters and input versus output token pricing differ.
Administrative registrations, unique models, launches and active users have different units.
Only explicitly numerical expressions permit exact decimal conversion.
Preserve direction and inclusivity; bounds are not points.
Do not assign numerical probabilities to idioms or vague qualifiers.
Preserve all antecedents and negation scope; never drop a condition.
Negating an estimate is not endorsing its complement or a zero probability.
Anchor relative dates to the utterance, not repost or retrieval; preserve timezone uncertainty.
Reporter, interviewer, quoted speaker and collective are distinct.
Endorsement is not a separate probability from each named signatory.
Respondent share, median elicited probability and author opinion are different quantities.
The English word survey and Chinese 调查 can denote different research designs.
Track lineage and revisions; publication on an official site does not automatically clear reuse rights.

query_templates.query_template: site:deepseek.com ("深度求索" OR "DeepSeek") ("发布" OR "研究" OR "风险" OR "安全")
query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Current releases and first-party risk discussion; do not treat model-generated chat answers as company views.

query_templates.query_template: ("Qwen" OR "通义千问") ("技术报告" OR "评测" OR "预计" OR "AGI")
query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Discover official Qwen releases/reports, then resolve current URLs from verified documentation; the translated brand term remains a search expansion, not automatic identity approval.

query_templates.query_template: site:github.com/zai-org ("GLM" OR "智谱") ("README_zh" OR "report" OR "安全")
query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Find first-party versioned artifacts; compare code, weight and paper licenses separately.

query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Filter results to verified official domains/repositories before attributing or copying.

query_templates.query_template: ("人工智能" OR "AI") ("生存性风险" OR "灾难性风险" OR "失控") ("共识" OR "声明" OR "框架")

query_templates.query_template: site:cac.gov.cn "生成式人工智能服务" ("备案" OR "登记")

query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Prefer original author/publisher pages and seek questionnaire, wave and data-availability details.
Literature review discovery only; survey in the title is not evidence of respondent data.

query_templates.query_template: {verified_actor_or_model_name} ("训练成本" OR "推理价格" OR "算力" OR "每百万")
query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Keep currency, model version, token direction and price basis; no paid API calls.

query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Name lookup must be verified independently; retrieve full question and answer, not a headline.

query_templates.query_template: ("生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法" OR "新一代人工智能伦理规范") ("修订" OR "发布")
query_templates.purpose_and_guardrail: Policy context, not probability or deployment measurement; present obligations require current legal verification.

workflow: Select a record family and primary source domain before combining terms.
Run simplified/traditional/English variants separately and log which form matched.
Require the primary page and sufficient context; search snippets alone are discovery metadata.
Retain negative and uncertain screening outcomes without converting silence to low risk.
Stop at authentication, access denial, unknown rights or ambiguous identity; request only the authorization actually needed.
